narrative_purpose: The chapter's representative plate for the landing book-map: a single Pandoran flyer seen so that the breathing fans along its flanks are the clear focal point - the whole chapter in one image.
subject: A large six-limbed Pandoran flying creature in profile-three-quarter view, wings half-spread, its body turned just enough that a pair of slotted, fan-like respiratory openings along its flank are clearly visible and flared open, catching an inner glow; the head and its small facial nostrils are deliberately turned away and dim, so the eye is drawn to the side-mounted fans, not the face.
scene: A dark naturalist's specimen space, the creature floating as if pinned in glowing display, deep atmospheric haze beyond.
camera: A clean three-quarter display view, the creature large and centred, the flank fans turned toward the viewer.
light: Bioluminescent key glowing from within the flank fans, cyan and teal; the rest of the body in deep indigo shadow; a faint warm rim on the far edge.
palette: Void-indigo ground, cyan and living-teal glow concentrated in the breathing fans, a scarce amber rim accent.
style: Painterly naturalist specimen plate, hand-painted texture, confident focal hierarchy.
detail_level: Crisp on the flank fans and their slotted structure; the body softer; the head quietest; edges dissolving into haze.
composition: Strong central figure, the glowing flank fans on the lower-third focal line, generous dark negative space around.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette, bioluminescent key from within the specimen. Same dark glowing-specimen mood as the established chapter covers.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no cartoon or anime style
